questions.question: Solve: |x - 12| > |3x + 4|
questions.explanation: Square both sides; simplify inequality → x < -4 or x > 8.

questions.question: Solve: (x² - 4x - 5)/(x + 3) ≤ 0
questions.explanation: Factor numerator: (x - 5)(x + 1). Sign chart → -5 < x < 1 (excluding -3).

questions.question: Solve: |3 - 2x| < x + 8
questions.explanation: RHS must be positive; solving absolute value inequality yields x > -5.

questions.question: Solve: |x + 2| + |x - 5| ≥ 12
questions.explanation: Testing regions around -2 and 5; inequality resolves to x ≤ -5 or x ≥ 7.

questions.question: Solve: (5x + 7)/(x - 3) > 0
questions.explanation: Expression positive when numerator and denominator have same sign.

questions.question: Solve: |2x + 1| ≥ 3x - 2
questions.explanation: Split absolute value and reduce; solution x ≤ -1 or x ≥ 3.

questions.question: Solve: |x - 1| < |x + 6|
questions.explanation: Distance from x to 1 less than distance to -6 ⇒ x closer to 1 ⇒ boundary at midpoint -2.5 ⇒ x > -2.5.

questions.question: Solve: (x² - 16)/(x + 1) ≥ 0
questions.explanation: Factor numerator: (x - 4)(x + 4). Do sign chart excluding x = -1.

questions.question: Solve: |5x - 2| ≥ |4 - x|
questions.explanation: Square both sides; roots and intervals yield x ≤ -4 or x ≥ 2.

questions.question: Solve: (2x - 1)(x + 5) < 0
questions.explanation: Product negative between roots: -5 < x < 1/2.

questions.question: Solve: |x + 8| < 2|x - 3|
questions.explanation: Square both sides; inequality reduces to x < -5 or x > 5.

questions.question: Solve: (3 - x)/(x² - 9) ≥ 0
questions.explanation: Denominator zeros at ±3; sign chart gives three intervals where expression ≥ 0.

questions.question: Solve: |4 - 3x| ≥ x + 10
questions.explanation: Split cases; inequality reduces to x ≤ -14 or x ≥ 2.

questions.question: Solve: (x - 9)/(x + 2) ≤ 1
questions.explanation: Bring terms together: (x - 9 - (x + 2))/(x + 2) ≤ 0 ⇒ (-11)/(x + 2) ≤ 0 ⇒ denominator negative ⇒ x < -2 OR numerator sign flip gives x ≥ 7.

questions.question: Solve: |x² - 4| ≥ x + 6
questions.explanation: Solve two inequalities: x² - 4 ≥ x + 6 and x² - 4 ≤ -x - 6.

questions.question: Solve: (2x + 9)/(5 - x) < 1
questions.explanation: Move all terms: (2x + 9 - (5 - x))/(5 - x) < 0 ⇒ (3x + 4)/(5 - x) < 0 ⇒ numerator and denominator opposite signs.

questions.question: Solve: |5 - x| + |x - 2| ≥ 10
questions.explanation: By testing regions around 2 and 5, inequality holds for x ≤ -3 or x ≥ 8.

questions.question: Solve: (x² - 11x + 24)/(x - 6) ≥ 0
questions.explanation: Factor numerator: (x - 3)(x - 8). Exclude 6. Sign chart yields ≤3 or ≥8.

questions.question: Solve: |x + 6| ≤ |2x - 3|
questions.explanation: Square both sides, solve quadratic inequality → x ≤ -1 or x ≥ 3.

questions.question: Solve: (3x - 1)/(x² - 4) > 0
questions.explanation: Denominator zero at ±2; numerator zero at 1/3. Sign chart gives x < -2 OR 1/3 < x < 2.

questions.question: Solve: |3x + 4| ≥ 2|x - 1|
questions.explanation: Square both sides, simplify quadratic inequality → x ≤ -3 or x ≥ 2.

questions.question: Solve: (x + 7)/(x² + x - 6) ≤ 0
questions.explanation: Denominator factors to (x + 3)(x - 2). Sign chart gives open intervals.

questions.question: Solve: |2 - x| > x + 4
questions.explanation: Solve two inequalities; solution reduces to x < -3.

questions.question: Solve: |x² - 1| ≤ 3x - 7
questions.explanation: RHS must be ≥ 0 ⇒ x ≥ 7/3. Testing inequality yields no x satisfies all constraints.

questions.question: Solve: (x² - 25)/(x - 7) ≥ 0
questions.explanation: Factor numerator: (x - 5)(x + 5). Sign chart with excluded 7 produces three valid intervals.
